# SmartTag

A tag for one of the five SMART competency areas. The `subject` fixes its color and leading icon, and the rest is passed to Tag.

Also asked as: skill tag.

**Import:** `import { SmartTag } from '@/components';`

**Source:** `design-system/src/components/labels/SmartTag/SmartTag.jsx`

**Stories:** `design-system/src/components/labels/SmartTag/SmartTag.stories.jsx` — Overview, CustomLabel, PassesThroughTagProps, UnknownSubjectFallsBack, Interactive, Rest, Hovered, Pressed, Focused, Disabled

**Storybook page:** `design-system/src/components/labels/SmartTag/SmartTag.mdx`

## Usage

Use `SmartTag` wherever training content, a tutor's strengths or a feedback
item is tagged by SMART area. For a category that is not a SMART subject, use
`Tag` directly: `SmartTag` exists only to fix the color and icon per subject,
not to add new behavior.

### Subject guidance

| Subject | Icon | Default label |
| --- | --- | --- |
| `social-emotional` | heart | Social-emotional |
| `mastering-content` | book | Mastering content |
| `advocacy` | bullhorn | Advocacy |
| `relationship` | handshake | Relationship |
| `technology-tools` | laptop-code | Technology tools |

Each subject's color and icon are fixed: there is no prop to mix a subject's
meaning with a different color.

## Best practices

### Keep the subject's own name. {#keep-the-subject-s-own-name}

The label defaults to the subject name; a long rewrite breaks the one-line tag. Override it with `children` or `text` only when the surrounding content needs a shorter or longer phrasing.

Do: The subject name.
Don't: A long custom label.

### Show each subject once. {#show-each-subject-once}

Repeating a subject adds nothing; a row lists the different subjects.

Do: Distinct subjects.
Don't: The same subject three times.

### Keep the icon with its label. {#keep-the-icon-with-its-label}

The icon is part of the subject's identity, so it is never dropped. A plain `Tag` in the subject's color loses it.

Do: Icon and label.
Don't: Label without the icon.

### Write the current spelling. {#write-the-current-spelling}

`socio-emotional` and `relationships` are accepted and map to
`social-emotional` and `relationship`. Write new code with the current
spelling; the aliases exist for content written before it changed.

## Accessibility

- **Inherits `Tag`'s accessibility.** Selection, removal and link behavior
  are unchanged; see `Tag`'s own Accessibility section for the full
  contract.
- **The subject icon is decorative.** It is `aria-hidden`; the subject's name
  is carried by the visible label, not the icon.

## Related

- For a category outside the five SMART subjects, use `Tag` directly.
- For a group of tags, including smart tags, use `TagGroup`.

Same group: `AiMessage` · `ChangeTag` · `CountTag` · `DateTag` · `PromptStarters` · `StatusTag` · `Suggestion` · `Tag` · `TagGroup`

## Parts

1. **Subject icon.** Fixed per subject: a heart, a book, a bullhorn, a handshake, a laptop. It is decoration.
2. **Label.** The subject's own name unless the context needs other words.
3. **Edge and ground.** The subject's hue on the border, with neutral text, exactly as Tag draws a color.

### States

| State | What changes |
| --- | --- |
| Rest | A span with no role. The five subjects are the hues orange, teal, lime, magenta and brown. |
| Hovered, pressed | None until `isSelected` makes it selectable; then the subject's subtlest and subtlest pressed steps, as Tag. |
| Focused | Only when selectable or removable: the 2px focus ring, 2px off the edge. |
| Disabled | `isDisabled`, or a disabled field, drops it to the disabled ground and words and removes the ×. |

### Tokens

| Part | Token |
| --- | --- |
| Rest edge | `--ds-border-accent-orange-subtle` for social-emotional, and the same step for each other subject hue. |
| Hovered, pressed | `--ds-background-accent-orange-subtlest` and `--ds-background-accent-orange-subtlest-pressed`. |
| Selected | `--ds-background-accent-orange-subtler` with a `--ds-border-accent-orange` edge. |
| Disabled | `--ds-background-disabled` with `--ds-text-disabled`. |
| Subject icon | `--icon-sm`, matching Tag's 12 text. |
| Height | 22, as Tag. |

## Content guidelines

| Do | Don't |
| --- | --- |
| Let the default label stand: "Mastering content". | Rename a subject to taste: "Math stuff". |
| Use a SMART tag only for a SMART subject. | Use one as a general colored label. Use Tag. |
| Write a custom label only where the context needs it, in the same register. | Shorten it to an abbreviation nobody has met. |

## Props

| Prop | Type | Default | Description |
|------|------|---------|-------------|
| `subject` | enum | — | The SMART subject. Fixes the Tag color and the leading icon. |
| `children` | node | — | The label (alternative to `text`). Defaults to the subject's own name. |
| `text` | string | — | The label (alternative to `children`). Defaults to the subject's own name. |

## Variants

**`subject`** — `social-emotional` · `mastering-content` · `advocacy` · `relationship` · `technology-tools` · `socio-emotional` · `relationships`
